packageRules.description: Major upgrades are never opened automatically: request them from the Dependency Dashboard.
Group Python minor/patch updates into one PR.
Group npm minor/patch updates into one PR.
Group Go module minor/patch updates into one PR.
Group GitHub Actions minor/patch/digest updates into one PR.
Group pre-commit hook updates into one PR.

Runtime versions (python, node) need explicit approval, whether a base image (Dockerfile, compose) or a setup-python/setup-node version in a workflow: CI tests Python 3.10 and 3.12 only, and a runtime bump is never a routine update. Their own group keeps them out of the routine github-actions PR.

Docker tags carry no release timestamp, and under minimumReleaseAge's default (timestamp-required) every Docker update would stay pending forever, even after dashboard approval. Let them through without the age check.
